title: full-suite advisory at reviewing→integrating misnames the phase and ignores the reviewer's captured full run
detail: gate._full_suite_gate is called both at building exit and at reviewing→integrating (gate.py ~1914, ~1924), but its problem text hard-codes 'no green prusik prove --kind tests recorded this building phase', so leaving reviewing reports 'building'. It also counts only prove_run events since the last phase_advance into the current phase: the regression-sentinel's full-suite run via 'prusik gate capture' (reports/<f>/regression.evidence.json, tests=1659, same worktree hash) is execution evidence prusik itself captured, yet it is not credited, so the advisory fires on a sprint whose reviewing phase did run the full suite. Seen on measured-token-usage (2026-10-26): the advance printed the advisory with regression PASS and evidence tests=1659. Fix: name the phase actually being left, and credit captured execution evidence for the current tree hash (or record a prove_run from capture).
